title: Form-file data-binding rules
summary: Six lint rules check the text .dfm beside a unit: bad data links, duplicate bindings, field-type mismatches, unreachable required fields
intro: Read this when you want lint to check how datasets, data sources and data-aware controls are wired in a .dfm. Run drag-lint lint <unit.pas> or lint-all; the checks run for any unit that has a text form file beside it. Each rule is selectable with --rule; disallowed-dfm-property needs entries in the disallowed.names config list that start with dfm:.
